name: pre-edit-collision-between-sessions
description: The control the release-effect rows (19, 20, 21) rely on: with no release in between, session A takes EXCLUSIVE on a tracked path (preflight pre-edit) and session B, a different top-level session, pre-edits the same path. B's acquire is allowed but reports the collision (ok+collision+allow envelope, as row 13 does for sibling subagents). Rows 19 to 21 expect the bare {ok:true}, so they can only fail on a release that did nothing while this row holds; if a change stopped reporting this collision, this row turns red instead of those rows passing for nothing. additionalContext names the holder and timestamps that vary per run, so it is ignored; the collision keys are the contract.
